verification.claim: analyzed 22,052 real-world security incidents, of which 12,195 were confirmed data breaches
verification.detail: This year, the Verizon DBIR team analyzed 22,052 real-world security incidents, of which 12,195 were confirmed data breaches that occurred inside organizations of all sizes and types.

verification.claim: 60% of breaches involved the human element
verification.detail: Although the involvement of the human element in breaches remained roughly the same as last year, hovering around 60%, the percentages of breaches where a third party was involved doubled, going from 15% to 30%.
